newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa ends mixed, coffee in late gains.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa ends mixed, coffee in late gains.

text.p: COCOA - Ends mixed, but nearby months weaker ahead of May's first notice on Thursday. July off four stg at 997 stg.
COFFEE - July scoops modest gains in late advance after NY hits new contract months. May/July spread widens further. July up $22 at $1,620.
SUGAR - Little changed in routine trade. NY up 30 cents at $312.50 at 1606 GMT.
